rejected_generalization: The documented legacy Metal1 normalization passes the original dummy cell and rejects altered W, L and deleted-resistor references. Whole-macro application is invalid: the macro contains Metal2 and Metal3 resistors and widths 0.20/0.24um, while the vendor CDL uses 0.26um. Neither aliasing every model to Metal1 nor disabling width comparison is accepted. The seeded KLayout attempt was stopped (-9 after SIGTERM did not stop comparison); Netgen stopped (-15). The earlier unseeded comparison hit its 600-second bound. No interrupted process is a pass.
hierarchy_findings: Cell-scoped DFPQD must-connect with strict top-level handling yields no unresolved extraction diagnostics in the bounded macro experiment. Flattening WLDRV and context-externalized cells preserves devices but does not establish top equivalence. Intermediate audit Match rows are not acceptance of the full macro.
